Subject: Solarflare onboarding pack + DPA / SOC2 link / subprocessor list

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the intro. Attached is the vendor onboarding packet we typically provide to enterprise customers — it includes our current DPA (Solarflare_DPA_v3.1.pdf) and a CSV export of our subprocessor roster. You can also view a short SOC 2 summary here: https://s3.solarflare.com/reports/soc2-2026-summary.html.

Quick notes:
- DPA: current version is attached (v3.1); we can accept reasonable counterchanges but prefer to keep security sections unchanged.
- Subprocessors: solarflare_subprocessors_2027-06.csv includes provider name, processing purpose, and region.
- Billing & PO: we normally invoice monthly via accounts@solarflarebilling.com; we accept Net 30 by default.

Could you confirm the PO flow on Redwood's side (contact for PO creation, required PO fields, any required GL/charge codes)? Also, do you need a completed vendor form or W-9 from us? I attached a blank W-9 and the DPA for review.

Attachments:
- Solarflare_DPA_v3.1.pdf (pdf)
- solarflare_subprocessors_2027-06.csv (csv)
- Solarflare_W9.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Liam O'Neill
Head of Partnerships

Subject: Re: Solarflare onboarding pack + DPA / SOC2 link / subprocessor list

Hi Liam — thanks for sending these over and for the quick SOC2 link. I've looped in Ben (commercial) and Irene (procurement/legal) to confirm PO and DPA next steps. A couple quick asks from our side: 

1) For procurement: can you confirm the remit-to address and whether you require any PO wording beyond standard services description? We typically need: Vendor name, address, tax ID, PO number, and a short service description.
2) For legal: are there any sections in v3.1 of the DPA you anticipate pushback on (security annex, subprocessing clause)? If you have a preferred signature method (DocuSign envelope id), share it and we can expedite.
3) Can you confirm billing cadence (monthly in arrears) and whether you have a minimum invoice amount?

Ben — can you confirm the internal PO owner and whether Redwood will require vendor questionnaire completion or a dedicated procurement intake form? Irene — can you flag any immediate DPA concerns you see so we can surface them back to Solarflare.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Solarflare onboarding pack + DPA / SOC2 link / subprocessor list

Hi Liam — welcome, and thanks for the packet. Quick answers to Mina's questions from the commercial side: 

- PO owner: I'll own the PO creation on our end once legal confirms the DPA. Procurement team typically issues a PO via our finance system with the following fields: PO number, vendor name, vendor remit address, Redwood cost center, invoice remit-to (accounts@solarflarebilling.com), and the consolidated service description "Solarflare API access — inference feature".
- Payment terms: Net 30 is fine; standard practice is monthly invoicing in arrears.
- Vendor form: We use a short procurement intake form for new vendor records (company info + tax ID + W9). If you can confirm the tax ID on your W-9 (attached) we'll add you to the system and generate a PO.

Next steps I propose:
1) Irene to review DPA (I've flagged minor commercial items we can accommodate).
2) Solarflare countersign or accept via DocuSign (if you send an envelope link, we'll expedite).
3) Once signed, procurement will create PO and route to your accounts email.

Irene, please confirm expected turnaround for DPA review and any redlines required.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Best regards,
Liam
